summary.en: As Conan is waking form Agasa house he sees Kogoro following someone. When he asks, Kogoro sends Conan home for dinner. A few days later at the Akaoni Village Fire Festival a burnt body is found in the fire. Location: Akaoni Village, Gunma Prefecture Victim: Masaki Negishi Cause of death: Burning Suspects: Yutaka Abe And when Kogoro finds out that the victim is the same man that he had been tailing for the past three days, he realizes that he has been had. The man who hired detective Mouri uses his testimony to create the perfect alibi. But Kogoro is sure that his client is the guilty one, and Conan agrees. Can Conan crack the case before this prime suspect leaves the country or will he get away with murder?
